name: outings
description: NPC friend networks, nights out and house parties. Each NPC with a home gets up to six friends, derived at boot from authored flags.friends, housemates, workmates and neighbours. Each evening's plan (who goes to which bar or club, who throws a house party at their flat) is seeded from the game date, so it's the same after any restart; tonight() lists it. Anyone due on shift drops out. RAM only, no queries.
